research_question: Can Native-60m volatility be represented by one causal, interpretable, slot-adjusted continuous state score that is stable across development years and prospectively separates next-bar intrabar risk?

adaptive_context_from_phase60b.allowed_use: Phase 60-B may motivate the fixed candidate family but may not be changed or reinterpreted.
observations_used_to_form_new_question: intrabar_rv_1m showed materially stronger lag continuity than 60m body magnitude
q90/q95 extreme episodes were usually one native 60m bar
small 60m bodies could coexist with high intrabar path energy

primitive_observables.body_abs_log: open-close body primitive retained as a compression benchmark

causal_slot_normalization.baseline: median of the previous same-slot observations only
causal_slot_normalization.formula: relative_level_t = observable_t / median(previous 60 finite observations from the same slot)
causal_slot_normalization.zero_current_value_policy: relative_level may be zero; no epsilon is added
causal_slot_normalization.warmup_policy: rows without 40 prior same-slot observations are unscored and may not be imputed

candidate_enumeration: Cartesian product of 4 base scores and 3 memory variants; no additions after preregistration.

primary_pair_semantics.next_bar: immediately following Native-60m bar within the same trading day only
primary_pair_semantics.overnight: PM2 to next-day AM1 is reported separately and cannot affect C1 selection

candidate_diagnostics: lag1/lag2/lag3 Pearson and Spearman persistence within day
next-bar intrabar_rv_1m mean and median by current score quartile
next-bar intrabar_rv_1m q90 event probability by current score quartile
top-quartile versus bottom-quartile next-bar intrabar_rv_1m mean ratio overall and by year
quartile monotonicity of next-bar intrabar_rv_1m mean
capture of Phase-60B compression cases: low body with high path energy
secondary PM2 to next-day AM1 persistence and next-day path-energy separation

selection_rule.eligible: candidate must satisfy every mechanism gate
selection_rule.if_none: status=NATIVE60_STATE_SCORE_SELECTION_INSUFFICIENT; no selected score; C2 not authorized
if_one_or_more: maximize the minimum yearly top/bottom next-bar intrabar_rv mean ratio
then maximize overall top/bottom next-bar intrabar_rv mean ratio
then maximize overall lag1 Spearman persistence
then prefer lower formula complexity: single primitive before composite
then prefer less smoothing: raw before ewma50 before ewma25
selection_rule.selected_score_authority: development score construction only; it is not a final risk state and has no threshold, probability, strategy or production authority

next_phase_contract.on_complete: may preregister Phase 60-C2 state thresholds / hysteresis and transition semantics using the frozen selected score; C2 must be a separate task
next_phase_contract.on_insufficient: C2 remains blocked; no post-result family expansion or gate relaxation under this task identity

non_rescue: do not add candidate families after C1 results are observed
do not alter 60/40 same-slot baseline semantics after reveal
do not alter smoothing variants after reveal
do not relax mechanism gates after reveal and call it the same C1
do not inspect 2024-2026 market values to choose or rescue a candidate
do not promote a selected score directly to Layer3 or production
